ns2:course.label: Sixteenth-Century Italian Art
ns2:course.description: Painting, sculpture, and architecture in Italy from 1500 to 1580. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing or consent of instructor.
